description.zh: 文明演化的结构化规则定义（Phase A：对象清单层）。基于 board-game-ontology v0.1.0。
description.en: Structured rule definition for Civolution (Phase A: object inventory). Based on board-game-ontology v0.1.0.

definition.zh: 文明演化中的胜利点数/成功点数。<success_point> 继承自 <score>。玩家通过推进进程轨、建造、安装研究牌、完成目标芯片、时代计分、终局计分等方式获得。游戏结束时拥有最多 <success_point> 的玩家获胜。
definition.en: Victory/success points in Civolution. <success_point> extends <score>. Players gain them through advancing progress tracks, building, installing research cards, completing goal chips, era scoring, and final scoring. The player with the most <success_point> at game end wins.

description.zh: 成功点数的计量单位为「分」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for success points: 'points'.

definition.zh: 文明演化中的食物资源，用于喂养阶段喂饱部落。<food> 继承自 <resource>。玩家通过狩猎、收入芯片、天气效果等获得。每有一个在营地或船上的部落需要 1 食物，每有一个在营地之外的部落需要 2 食物。
definition.en: Food resource in Civolution, used in the Feeding phase to feed tribes. <food> extends <resource>. Players gain it through hunting, income chips, weather effects, etc. Each tribe on an encampment or boat requires 1 food; each tribe in the wilderness requires 2 food.

definition.zh: 文明演化中的钱币资源，主要用于交易模组购买材料。<money> 继承自 <resource>。玩家通过出售仓库中的材料获得。
definition.en: Money resource in Civolution, mainly used by the Trade module to purchase materials. <money> extends <resource>. Players gain it by selling stored materials.

definition.zh: 已运输到个人面板仓库中的原材料。<stored_material> 继承自 <resource>。是建造聚落/雕像、支付研究牌费用、出售换钱的资源。同类型材料完全等价。
definition.en: Raw materials that have been transported to the storage spaces on a player's console. <stored_material> extends <resource>. Used to build settlements/statues, pay research card costs, or sell for money. Same-type materials are equivalent.

description.zh: 仓库材料的类型：木头、纸莎草、油、石头、铜、金/玉。
description.en: Type of stored material: Wood, Papyrus, Oil, Stone, Copper, Gold/Jade.

description.zh: 仓库材料的计量单位为「个」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for stored materials: 'marker'.

definition.zh: 放置在公共版图区域或船上的未运输材料标记。<raw_material> 继承自 <token>。它代表某种材料但尚未进入玩家仓库，需要通过运输才能变成 <stored_material>。
definition.en: A material marker placed on a region or boat on the public board, not yet transported to storage. <raw_material> extends <token>. It represents a material but is not yet in the player's storage; must be transported to become a <stored_material>.

description.zh: 此标记最终将运输为哪一种 <stored_material>，由所在区域的材料板块决定。
description.en: Which <stored_material> this marker will become when transported, determined by the material tile of its region.

definition.zh: 放置在个人面板特征格上的标记，代表玩家拥有的某种特征。<feature_marker> 继承自 <token>。特征用于满足研究牌费用、获取属性芯片、时代计分等。
definition.en: A marker placed on a feature space of a player's console, representing a feature the player has. <feature_marker> extends <token>. Features are used to satisfy research card costs, acquire attribute chips, and score in the Evolution category.

description.zh: 特征类型：智慧、表达、敏捷、耐力、镇定、感知。部分中文名称待最终确认。
description.en: Feature type: Intelligence, Expression, Dexterity, Stamina, Calm, Perception. Some names pending final confirmation.

definition.zh: 代表玩家文明在公共版图上存在的核心 <piece>。<tribe> 继承自 <piece>。每个部落有两种状态：站立（strong）和躺倒（weak）。只有站立部落可以迁徙；躺倒部落在喂养阶段若未被喂饱会死亡。
definition.en: The core <piece> representing a player's civilization on the public board. <tribe> extends <piece>. Each tribe has two states: strong (upright) and weak (lying). Only strong tribes can migrate; weak tribes die in the Feeding phase if not fed.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的米宝形木质指示物。站立放置表示 strong 状态，躺倒放置表示 weak 状态。
description.en: A meeple-shaped wooden marker in the player's color. Upright placement indicates strong state; lying placement indicates weak state.

definition.zh: 玩家建造在建造点上的大型建筑 <piece>。<settlement> 继承自 <piece>。每位玩家最多建造 4 个聚落。建造后获得收入芯片并立即执行，建造第 4 个时可激活层级四或层级五板块。
definition.en: A large building <piece> built by a player on a Building ground. <settlement> extends <piece>. Each player can build at most 4 settlements. Building one grants an income chip and executes it immediately; building the 4th allows flipping a stage-4 or stage-5 tile to active.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小房屋造型木质建筑件，放置后不能再主动移除。
description.en: A small house-shaped wooden building piece in the player's color; cannot be voluntarily removed after placement.

definition.zh: 玩家建造在陆地区域的农业建筑 <piece>。<farm> 继承自 <piece>。每位玩家最多建造 3 个农场。农场可减少同区域部落在喂养阶段的食物消耗，且建造后获得一个创意标记。
definition.en: An agricultural building <piece> built by a player on a land territory. <farm> extends <piece>. Each player can build at most 3 farms. A farm reduces the food cost for tribes in the same territory during the Feeding phase, and building one grants 1 idea marker.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小农场造型建筑件。火山相邻区域不能建造农场。
description.en: A small farm-shaped building piece in the player's color. Cannot be built in territories adjacent to a Volcano.

definition.zh: 玩家建造在水域区域的 <piece>。<boat> 继承自 <piece>。每艘船最多容纳 2 个同玩家部落，并提供在水域区域进行迁徙、生产、狩猎等活动的能力。每位玩家最多建造 2 艘船。
definition.en: A <piece> built by a player on a Water territory. <boat> extends <piece>. Each boat can hold up to 2 tribes of the same player and enables migration, production, hunting, etc. on Water territories. Each player can build at most 2 boats.

description.zh: 玩家颜色的小船造型建筑件，中央有凹槽放置材料标记。
description.en: A small boat-shaped building piece in the player's color, with a central notch for holding a raw material marker.

definition.zh: 用通用标记放置在建造点上的建筑标记。<statue> 继承自 <token>。建造后推进任意进程轨 1 格，并在之后的每个收入阶段按阿格拉恩惠轨位置计分。每位玩家在每个建造点可建 1 个聚落加 1 个雕像，或 2 个雕像。
definition.en: A building marker placed on a Building ground using a generic marker. <statue> extends <token>. Building one advances any progress track by 1 step, and each statue scores in subsequent Income phases based on the Favor of Agera track position. Each player may build 1 settlement + 1 statue or 2 statues per Building ground.

definition.zh: 玩家个人面板上的可激活 <piece>，提供各种行动。<module> 继承自 <piece>。共有 22 个模组：15 个主模组（可升级）、6 个特征模组和 1 个睡眠模组。激活模组需要支付两个对应点数的白骰子（或用计划/焦点标记替代）。
definition.en: An activatable <piece> on a player's console that provides various actions. <module> extends <piece>. There are 22 modules in total: 15 main modules (upgradable), 6 feature modules, and 1 Sleep module. Activating a module requires paying 2 activation dice of the matching values (or using planning/focus markers instead).

description.zh: 矩形 cardboard 板块，正面印有费用点数（左下、右下）和行动图标，背面或下层为升级后的更强效果。
description.en: A rectangular cardboard tile printed with activation costs (bottom-left and bottom-right) and action icons; the back or lower layer shows the upgraded, stronger effect.

description.zh: 模组类型：主模组（可升级）、特征模组、睡眠模组。
description.en: Module type: main (upgradable), feature, or sleep.

definition.zh: 可升级的行动模组，共有 15 种：迁徙、繁育、生产、运输、给养、探索、建造、计划、研究、成就、洞悉、突变、发明、交易、活动。<main_module> 继承自 <module>。每个主模组有等级一、二、三，通过升级行动翻面或移除上层板块实现。
definition.en: Upgradable action modules. There are 15 types: Migration, Procreation, Production, Transport, Sustenance, Exploration, Building, Planning, Research, Achievement, Insight, Mutation, Invention, Trade, Activity. <main_module> extends <module>. Each has levels I, II, and III, upgraded by flipping or removing the upper tile.

definition.zh: 用于获取特征标记的模组，共 6 个，分别对应 6 种特征。<feature_module> 继承自 <module>。激活需要两个相同点数的白骰子。
definition.en: Modules used to gain feature markers. There are 6, each corresponding to one of the 6 features. <feature_module> extends <module>. Activation requires 2 activation dice showing the same value.

definition.zh: 填充用模组，可用任意两个白骰子激活。效果是获得 2 个创意标记或 1 个焦点标记。
definition.en: A filler module that can be activated with any two activation dice. Its effect is to gain 2 idea markers or 1 focus marker.

definition.zh: 放置在个人面板创意格上的标记，用于修改骰子点数。<idea_marker> 继承自 <token>。每消耗 1 个创意标记可将任意骰子点数加减 1（1 和 6 相连）。
definition.en: A marker placed on a player's idea space, used to modify die values. <idea_marker> extends <token>. Spending 1 idea marker increases or decreases a die value by 1 (1 and 6 are adjacent).

definition.zh: 放置在骰子格上的标记，可替代对应点数的白骰子用于激活模组。<planning_marker> 继承自 <token>。只能替代白骰子，不能替代粉骰子。
definition.en: A marker placed on a dice space, usable in place of an activation die of the matching value. <planning_marker> extends <token>. Can only replace activation dice, not fate dice.

definition.zh: 特殊的计划标记，可当作任意一个骰子格中的计划标记使用。<focus_marker> 继承自 <token>。一个焦点标记相当于一个任意点数的白骰子。
definition.en: A special planning marker that can be used as a planning marker of any value. <focus_marker> extends <token>. One focus marker is equivalent to an activation die of any value.

definition.zh: 可安装到个人面板阶段区的 <card>。<research_card> 继承自 <card>。每张研究牌分三部分：上部为能力（可能为活动能力或被动效果），中部为 5 个费用格，下部为安装奖励。共 5 种类型：建造（蓝）、洞悉（黄）、突变（绿）、成就（紫）、发明（棕）。
definition.en: A <card> that can be installed in the stage partition of a player's console. <research_card> extends <card>. Each card has three parts: top ability (activity or passive effect), middle 5 cost spaces, bottom install bonus. Five types: Building (blue), Insight (yellow), Mutation (green), Achievement (purple), Invention (brown).

description.zh: 矩形卡牌，顶部为能力区，中部为 5 个费用格，底部为安装奖励。卡牌左上角可能有类型颜色标识。
description.en: A rectangular card with an ability area at the top, 5 cost spaces in the middle, and an install bonus at the bottom. The top-left may show the type color.

description.zh: 研究牌类型：建造、洞悉、突变、成就、发明。
description.en: Research card type: Building, Insight, Mutation, Achievement, Invention.

definition.zh: 每时代翻开一张的 <card>，决定本时代天气变化和事件奖励。<event_card> 继承自 <card>。右上角指示天气标记移动方向和步数，下方为事件效果。
definition.en: A <card> revealed once per era, determining the era's weather change and event bonus. <event_card> extends <card>. The top-right indicates weather movement direction and steps; the lower part shows the event effect.

definition.zh: 设置阶段使用的 <card>，记录玩家初始可获得的标记。<starting_marker_card> 继承自 <card>。设置完成后放回盒子。
definition.en: A <card> used during setup indicating which markers a player starts with. <starting_marker_card> extends <card>. Returned to the box after setup.

definition.zh: 设置阶段使用的 <card>，记录玩家首个升级的模组和首个收入芯片。<starting_chip_card> 继承自 <card>。设置完成后塞入个人面板成为第一个收入芯片。
definition.en: A <card> used during setup indicating the player's first upgraded module and first income chip. <starting_chip_card> extends <card>. After setup, it is slid under the console as the first income chip.

definition.zh: 可安装到个人面板的白色芯片，提供收入阶段可执行的持续效果。<income_chip> 继承自 <piece>。每张收入芯片有两个可选效果，执行时二选一。收入芯片可安装在任意列。
definition.en: A white chip that can be installed in a player's console, providing an effect usable in Income phases. <income_chip> extends <piece>. Each income chip has two optional effects; when executing, choose one. Income chips can be installed in any column.

definition.zh: 蓝色的芯片，玩家从展示区拿取后安装在个人面板目标列。<goal_chip> 继承自 <piece>。安装后可能揭示升级奖励。每叠目标芯片安装完后可升级一个模组。
definition.en: A blue chip taken from the display and installed in the goal column of a player's console. <goal_chip> extends <piece>. Installing one may reveal an upgrade bonus. Completing a stack of goal chips allows upgrading one main module.

definition.zh: 黄色的芯片，玩家在自己的回合任何时候满足条件即可拿取并安装。<attribute_chip> 继承自 <piece>。安装后提供持续效果。
definition.en: A yellow chip that a player may take and install at any time during their turn if they meet its requirement. <attribute_chip> extends <piece>. Provides a continuous effect after installation.

definition.zh: 双面 <tile>，一面印有计分类别图标，另一面印有分数。<scoring_tile> 继承自 <tile>。设置时 4 张图标面朝上放入时代计分区，3 张分数面朝上覆盖终局计分区对应格。
definition.en: A double-sided <tile> with a scoring category icon on one side and a point value on the other. <scoring_tile> extends <tile>. During setup, 4 are placed icon-side up in the era scoring area, and 3 are placed point-side up in the final scoring area.

definition.zh: 标识个人面板阶段 4 和阶段 5 是否激活的 <tile>。<stage_tile> 继承自 <tile>。未激活面朝上时，该阶段的卡牌/芯片终局不计分；激活后翻面，才计分。
definition.en: A <tile> indicating whether stage 4 or stage 5 of a player's console is active. <stage_tile> extends <tile>. When the inactive side is up, cards/chips in that stage score nothing at final scoring; flip to active to enable scoring.

definition.zh: 放置在公共版图上的特殊地点，翻开前背面朝上。<site_tile> 继承自 <site>。共 9 种：建造点、狼谷、冰川、神秘橡树、隐蔽洞窟、圣岩、洞穴、蘑菇谷、火山。每种效果不同。
definition.en: Special sites placed on the public board, face down until revealed. <site_tile> extends <site>. Nine types: Building ground, Gorge of the Grimwolves, Glacier, Mystic oak, Hidden grotto, Holy rock, Cave, Mushroom valley, Volcano. Each has a different effect.

definition.zh: 拼成公共版图的 <tile>。<continent_tile> 继承自 <tile>。共 8 块，其中 7 块为 2×1 大小，1 块为 1×1 大小。板块正面印有不同的 <terrain> 区域和营地位置。
definition.en: A <tile> forming part of the public continent board. <continent_tile> extends <tile>. There are 8 tiles: seven 2×1 and one 1×1. The front is printed with different <terrain> regions and encampment positions.

definition.zh: 放置在大陆板块材料格上的 <tile>，决定所在区域可产出的材料类型。<material_tile> 继承自 <tile>。正面朝上时表示该区域已开发，可产出对应材料。
definition.en: A <tile> placed on a material space of a continent tile, determining what material the region produces. <material_tile> extends <tile>. When face up, the region is developed and can produce the corresponding material.

definition.zh: 深绿色的 <terrain> 类型。
definition.en: A dark green <terrain> type.

definition.zh: 浅绿色的 <terrain> 类型。
definition.en: A light green <terrain> type.

definition.zh: 土黄色的 <terrain> 类型。
definition.en: A yellowish-brown <terrain> type.

definition.zh: 紫色的 <terrain> 类型。
definition.en: A purple <terrain> type.

definition.zh: 灰色的 <terrain> 类型，通常有立体边缘便于识别边界。
definition.en: A gray <terrain> type, often with raised edges to identify borders.

definition.zh: 黄色的 <terrain> 类型。
definition.en: A yellow <terrain> type.

definition.zh: 蓝色的 <terrain> 类型，代表水域区域。
definition.en: A blue <terrain> type representing water areas.

definition.zh: 白色的六面骰，用于激活模组。
definition.en: A white six-sided die used to activate modules.

definition.zh: 粉色的六面骰，用于恩惠检定、狩猎、幸运收获等。
definition.en: A pink six-sided die used for favor tests, hunting, and lucky finds.

definition.zh: 双面圆形指示物，正面为 100 分，背面为阻挡标记。<hundred_point_token> 继承自 <token>。玩家分数每超过 100 时拿取一个；设置时部分需翻面作为阻挡标记覆盖不可用区域。
definition.en: A double-sided round token with 100 points on the front and a blocking side on the back. <hundred_point_token> extends <token>. Players take one whenever their score passes 100; some are flipped as blocking tokens during setup.

definition.zh: 放置在已狩猎区域上的标记，表示本时代该区域不能再被狩猎。<hunting_token> 继承自 <token>。收入阶段结束时全部回收。背面也用作阻挡标记覆盖营地。
definition.en: A marker placed on a hunted territory, indicating that territory cannot be hunted again this era. <hunting_token> extends <token>. All are returned at the end of the Income phase. The back is also used as a blocking token for encampments.

definition.zh: 双面标记，正面为狩猎指示物，背面为阻挡标记。<territory_token> 继承自 <token>。在 2/3 人游戏中用于覆盖不可用营地。
definition.en: A double-sided token: front is a hunting token, back is a blocking token. <territory_token> extends <token>. Used to cover unavailable encampments in 2/3-player games.

definition.zh: 六边形标记，放置在流程版图阶段序列上指示当前阶段。<phase_indicator> 继承自 <token>。行动阶段中玩家执行重置时沿黄色箭头移动。
definition.en: A hexagonal marker placed on the phase sequence of the sequence board to indicate the current phase. <phase_indicator> extends <token>. Moves along the yellow arrow during the Action phase when players perform a Reset.

definition.zh: 圆柱形标记，放置在流程版图天气轨上指示当前天气。<weather_indicator> 继承自 <token>。每时代事件阶段根据事件牌移动并结算效果。
definition.en: A cylindrical marker placed on the weather gauge of the sequence board to indicate the current weather. <weather_indicator> extends <token>. Moved and resolved each era during the Event phase based on the event card.

definition.zh: 文明演化中的 <starting_player_marker>，标记当前起始玩家。
definition.en: The <starting_player_marker> in Civolution, marking the current starting player.

definition.zh: 由 <continent_tile> 拼接而成的公共游戏版图。<public_board> 继承自 <public_board>（本体）。包含多个 <region>、<campsite>、<site_tile> 和 <material_tile>，是 <tribe>、<settlement>、<farm>、<boat> 等 <piece> 的主要放置区。
definition.en: The shared game board assembled from <continent_tile>s. <public_board> extends the <public_board> ontology. It contains multiple <region>s, <campsite>s, <site_tile>s, and <material_tile>s, and is the main placement area for <tribe>, <settlement>, <farm>, and <boat> pieces.

definition.zh: 本局游戏中由全部 <continent_tile> 拼接形成的大陆。<continent> 继承自 <public_board>。2/3 人局时会使用阻挡标记覆盖部分不可用营地。
definition.en: The entire landmass formed by all <continent_tile>s in this game. <continent> extends <public_board>. In 2/3-player games, blocking tokens cover some unavailable campsites.

definition.zh: 公共版图上的一片连续 <terrain> 区域。<territory> 继承自 <region>。每个领地有一个地形类型，可能有一个或多个营地。领地是生产、狩猎、迁徙、建造等活动的基本单位。
definition.en: A contiguous area of the same <terrain> on the public board. <territory> extends <region>. Each territory has one terrain type and may have one or more campsites. Territories are the basic unit for production, hunting, migration, and building.

definition.zh: 位于 <territory> 内的圆形标记位置，用于放置 <tribe>。<campsite> 继承自 <campsite>（本体）。某些特殊营地（如火边营地）可提供分数。
definition.en: A circular marker position within a <territory> used to hold <tribe>s. <campsite> extends the <campsite> ontology. Some special campsites (e.g., Fireside Encampment) provide points.

definition.zh: 独立的计分轨 <public_board>，用于记录所有玩家的 <success_point>。<score_board> 继承自 <public_board>。玩家分数超过 100 时使用 <hundred_point_token> 表示。
definition.en: A separate scoring-track <public_board> used to track all players' <success_point>s. <score_board> extends <public_board>. <hundred_point_token>s are used when scores exceed 100.

definition.zh: 记录当前时代、当前阶段、当前天气的 <private_board>。<sequence_board> 继承自 <private_board>。上有 <favor_of_ager_track>、天气轨和阶段序列。
definition.en: A <private_board> tracking the current era, current phase, and current weather. <sequence_board> extends <private_board>. Holds the <favor_of_ager_track>, weather gauge, and phase sequence.

definition.zh: 位于 <sequence_board> 上的分数轨，记录当前阿格拉恩惠等级。<favor_of_ager_track> 继承自 <track>。影响 <favor_test> 成功范围、雕像收入和终局计分。
definition.en: A scoring track on the <sequence_board> recording the current Favor of Agera level. <favor_of_ager_track> extends <track>. It affects the success range of <favor_test>s, statue income, and final scoring.

definition.zh: 位于 <sequence_board> 上的轨，记录当前天气。<weather_gauge> 继承自 <track>。天气有晴天、雨天、雪天、暴风雪、干燥等，影响收成、狩猎和灾难。
definition.en: A track on the <sequence_board> recording the current weather. <weather_gauge> extends <track>. Weather states include sunny, rainy, snowy, blizzard, dry, etc., affecting harvest, hunting, and disasters.

definition.zh: <sequence_board> 上用于放置本时代计分 <scoring_tile> 的区域。<era_scoring_area> 继承自 <public_zone>。时代计分阶段按图标类别结算。
definition.en: An area on the <sequence_board> for placing the era <scoring_tile>s. <era_scoring_area> extends <public_zone>. Resolved during the Era Scoring phase by icon category.

definition.zh: <sequence_board> 上用于放置终局计分 <scoring_tile> 的区域。<final_scoring_area> 继承自 <public_zone>。游戏结束时按分数面朝上的数值结算。
definition.en: An area on the <sequence_board> for placing final <scoring_tile>s. <final_scoring_area> extends <public_zone>. Resolved at game end by the point values shown face up.

definition.zh: 每位玩家的个人游戏面板，包含模组区、阶段区、目标列、属性列、收入区、仓库、特征格、创意格、骰子区等。<player_console> 继承自 <private_board>。
definition.en: Each player's personal board containing the module area, stage partition, goal column, attribute column, income area, storage, feature spaces, idea spaces, and dice area. <player_console> extends <private_board>.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上放置 <module> 的区域，有固定的 22 个槽位。<module_area> 继承自 <player_zone>。主模组可升级，睡眠模组和特征模组固定不变。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> where <module>s are placed, with 22 fixed slots. <module_area> extends <player_zone>. Main modules can be upgraded; sleep and feature modules are fixed.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上放置 <activation_die>、<fate_die>、<planning_marker> 的区域。<dice_area> 继承自 <player_zone>。骰子掷出后放在对应点数格上。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> for <activation_die>s, <fate_die>s, and <planning_marker>s. <dice_area> extends <player_zone>. Rolled dice are placed on the matching value spaces.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上放置 <idea_marker> 的格子。<idea_space> 继承自 <player_zone>。上限 12 个，超过不丢弃但无法继续获得。
definition.en: A space on the <player_console> for holding <idea_marker>s. <idea_space> extends <player_zone>. Capacity is 12; excess markers cannot be gained but are not discarded.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上放置 <feature_marker> 的格子，共 6 种。<feature_space> 继承自 <player_zone>。某些效果可覆盖特征标记的获取上限。
definition.en: A space on the <player_console> for holding <feature_marker>s, one for each of the 6 features. <feature_space> extends <player_zone>. Some effects may bypass the normal feature-marker cap.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上按阶段 1~5 划分、用于安装 <research_card> 的区域。<stage_partition> 继承自 <player_zone>。阶段 4 和阶段 5 初始未激活，需通过建造第 4 个聚落激活。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> divided into stages 1-5 for installing <research_card>s. <stage_partition> extends <player_zone>. Stages 4 and 5 start inactive and are unlocked by building the 4th settlement.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上存放 <stored_material> 的区域。<storage_area> 继承自 <player_zone>。同类型材料堆叠放置，可通过交易模组出售换钱。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> for storing <stored_material>s. <storage_area> extends <player_zone>. Same-type materials are stacked and can be sold via the Trade module.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上用于安装 <goal_chip> 的列。<goal_column> 继承自 <player_zone>。每完成一叠目标芯片可升级一个主模组。
definition.en: The column on the <player_console> for installing <goal_chip>s. <goal_column> extends <player_zone>. Completing a stack of goal chips allows upgrading one main module.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上用于安装 <attribute_chip> 的列。<attribute_column> 继承自 <player_zone>。属性芯片一旦安装即提供持续效果。
definition.en: The column on the <player_console> for installing <attribute_chip>s. <attribute_column> extends <player_zone>. Installed attribute chips provide continuous effects.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上用于安装 <income_chip> 的区域。<income_area> 继承自 <player_zone>。收入阶段从上到下、从左到右依次执行。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> for installing <income_chip>s. <income_area> extends <player_zone>. Income chips execute top-to-bottom, left-to-right during the Income phase.

definition.zh: <player_console> 上放置因未喂饱而死亡的 <tribe> 的区域。<dead_tribe_area> 继承自 <player_zone>。死亡部落在终局计分时有影响。
definition.en: The area on the <player_console> for <tribe>s that died from starvation. <dead_tribe_area> extends <player_zone>. Dead tribes affect final scoring.

definition.zh: 公共版图上展示可拿取 <research_card> 的区域。<card_market> 继承自 <market>。研究牌按类型和时代排列成列。
definition.en: The public area displaying available <research_card>s. <card_market> extends <market>. Research cards are arranged in columns by type and era.

definition.zh: 公共版图上展示可拿取 <goal_chip> 和 <attribute_chip> 的区域。<chip_display> 继承自 <market>。
definition.en: The public area displaying available <goal_chip>s and <attribute_chip>s. <chip_display> extends <market>.

definition.zh: 放置未使用 <module> 的公共区域。<module_supply> 继承自 <supply>。设置时每位玩家拿取自己的一套模组。
definition.en: The public area holding unused <module>s. <module_supply> extends <supply>. During setup each player takes their own set of modules.

definition.zh: 放置未使用 <site_tile> 的区域。<site_supply> 继承自 <supply>。设置时洗混并随机放到大陆对应位置，背面朝上。
definition.en: The area holding unused <site_tile>s. <site_supply> extends <supply>. Shuffled and randomly placed face down on the continent during setup.

definition.zh: 放置未使用 <continent_tile> 的区域。<continent_tile_supply> 继承自 <supply>。设置时洗混并拼接成公共版图。
definition.en: The area holding unused <continent_tile>s. <continent_tile_supply> extends <supply>. Shuffled and assembled into the public board during setup.

definition.zh: 放置未使用 <material_tile> 的区域。<material_tile_supply> 继承自 <supply>。设置时随机放到大陆对应材料格上。
definition.en: The area holding unused <material_tile>s. <material_tile_supply> extends <supply>. Randomly placed on the corresponding material spaces of the continent during setup.

definition.zh: 放置未使用 <scoring_tile> 的区域。<scoring_tile_supply> 继承自 <supply>。设置时抽出 4 张时代计分和 3 张终局计分。
definition.en: The area holding unused <scoring_tile>s. <scoring_tile_supply> extends <supply>. During setup, 4 are drawn for era scoring and 3 for final scoring.

definition.zh: 放置 <event_card> 的牌堆。<event_deck> 继承自 <deck>。每个时代翻开最上面一张。
definition.en: The deck holding <event_card>s. <event_deck> extends <deck>. The top card is revealed each era.

definition.zh: 放置未展示 <research_card> 的牌堆。<research_deck> 继承自 <deck>。按类型和时代分为多个子牌堆。
definition.en: The deck holding unrevealed <research_card>s. <research_deck> extends <deck>. Divided into sub-decks by type and era.

definition.zh: 放置 <starting_marker_card> 的牌堆。<starting_marker_deck> 继承自 <deck>。设置后不再使用。
definition.en: The deck holding <starting_marker_card>s. <starting_marker_deck> extends <deck>. Not used after setup.

definition.zh: 放置 <starting_chip_card> 的牌堆。<starting_chip_deck> 继承自 <deck>。设置后作为第一个收入芯片塞入个人面板。
definition.en: The deck holding <starting_chip_card>s. <starting_chip_deck> extends <deck>. After setup, it becomes the first income chip slid under the console.

definition.zh: 《文明演化》纸质规则书，用于查询详细规则。
definition.en: The printed rulebook for Civolution, used for detailed rule lookups.

definition.zh: 帮助玩家理解阶段顺序和图标含义的辅助卡。<player_aid> 继承自 <player_aid>（本体）。
definition.en: A card helping players understand phase order and icon meanings. <player_aid> extends the <player_aid> ontology.

description.zh: Civolution 玩家保留区通用引用，主要指玩家手牌中的研究牌。
description.en: Generic player holding reference in Civolution, mainly referring to research cards in hand.
